## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/kayo-willian/oppy/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Automated tests remain offline; source access conditions are respected.
- [ ] Existing state, configuration and delivery guarantees are preserved, or compatibility changes are explained.
- [ ] Regression tests and documentation are updated, or not applicable.
- [ ] Significant user-visible changes are recorded in CHANGELOG.md, or not applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, private data or unsanitized snapshots are included.
- [ ] I reviewed the changes and disclosed material AI assistance, if used.
